items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: there was a conductor at Juilliard, Jean Morel, great conductor but very French and disciplined.

ctx.x: This is almost an aside but I watched an interview with you, I think it was fairly recent, it was another young man there, and somehow this bit about fixed Do and movable Do came up. And I have to say I’d never heard of such a thing until my own daughter brought it up, who is a music teacher, and it was something about Eastman School of Music. And I said, “What are you talking about?”

Well oh Christ — it’s solfeggio you know it’s like fixed Do would be C is do. And so Do Re Me Fa So La Ti Do in the key of C. But movable it would be Do would be the fundamental of the key you’re in, like A flat would be Do. So I don’t know, I was never good at — as Jonathan Tunick, this classmate of mine, used to say I used to put on my shades and read the New York Post in solfeggio class, which I don’t remember. But you know conductors like — there was a conductor at Juilliard, Jean Morel, great conductor but…
Oh you can’t make those things up.
